scripts.test: npm run test:runtime && npm run test:types
scripts.test:runtime: rm -rf .test-build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --outDir .test-build --noEmit false && node --test test/component.test.mjs
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --jsx react-jsx --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck test/types.test.tsx MemoFieldSet.tsx
